title: [29.x]Report 400 (Remittance Advice) Does Not Include Applied Vendor Refund Entries Resulting in Incorrect Total Calculation
summary: Report 400 (Remittance Advice) now includes applied vendor refund entries that share the payment's vendor number and document number, ensuring the printed line items match the calculated total.
key_points: Refund entries are now identified and displayed as lines when they share the payment's vendor and document number
Payment discount logic is skipped for refund entries to prevent incorrect calculations
Report total is adjusted by subtracting line amounts to reconcile with displayed line items
Fixes discrepancy where listed lines did not match the printed total
quote: The report only surfaced entries from the payment's own application chain, missing refunds applied through a separate chain.
